{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Metal Ox''' (辛丑, ''kanoto ushi''; onyomi ''shinchū'') is the 38th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 38th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Metal Rat|ja|庚子}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Water Tiger|ja|壬寅}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''辛'' is Yin Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''丑'' (Ox) is Yin Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Metal Ox (辛丑)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): xīnchǒu
** Cantonese (Jyutping): san1 cau2
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: kanoto-ushi
*** On'yomi: shinchū
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): sinchuk (신축)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Tân Sửu

=== Events ===
* In {{ill|Guangxu Era|ja|光緒|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Guangxu|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1135852}} 27th Year and {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji era}} 34th Year (1901 AD) – The {{ill|Boxer Protocol|ja|辛丑和約|lt=Beijing Protocol|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Beijing Protocol|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 北京議定書|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q672556}}, concerning the Boxer Rebellion (excluding Russia) among a coalition of 11 countries (including Austria, Britain, and France) and the Qing Empire, was signed.
==Months of Yin Metal Ox==
In a Western calendar year whose last digit is either 1 or 6 (corresponding to the Heavenly Stems {{ill|Kanoto (辛)|ja|辛|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Xin}} and {{ill|Hinoe (丙)|ja|丙|lt=Hinoe (丙)|2=ja|3=丙|4=zh|5=丙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bing}}), the month of December becomes the Yin Metal Ox month. Note that here "month" may refer either to the month of the old calendar or to a seasonal month defined from {{ill|Xiaohan|en|Xiaohan|qid=Q1190989|lt=Xiaohan}} until the day before {{ill|Lichun|en|Lichun|qid=Q1364685|lt=Risshun}}.

==Days of Yin Metal Ox==
=== 選日 ===
The Yin Metal Ox day is the 9th day of {{ill|Tenitsu-shin|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tian Yi Tian Shang|ja_comment=天一神|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
